name: openclaw-weixin-vendored
description: Vendored subset of @tencent-weixin/openclaw-weixin 2.4.10 (MIT): the iLink transport (api/, auth/, storage/, util/), the CDN upload/download and AES-128-ECB media layer (cdn/, media/) and the messaging layer (markdown-filter.js, send.js, send-media.js, quote-store.js). The three openclaw/plugin-sdk imports and one package-internal getMediaLabel import are redirected to ./openclaw-shim.js; see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
